protocols.title: Sleep schedule adjustment
protocols.summary: Protect a longer sleep window when sleep drops relative to baseline.

steps.text: Reserve a sleep window of at least 8 hours in the next cycle.
Keep a steady bedtime for the next 3 days.
Reduce bright light and screens in the hour before sleep.
On waking, record how many hours were slept and how rested you feel.

protocols.title: Workload adjustment
protocols.summary: Ease the load when fatigue rises or heart rate variability falls.

steps.text: Postpone non-essential tasks for the next 24 hours.
Split long tasks into short blocks with breaks.
Avoid critical tasks during the time of day with the most reported tiredness.
Tell the commander about the workload adjustment, without clinical detail.

protocols.title: Hydration and rest
protocols.summary: General supportive measures while the trend is monitored.

steps.text: Drink water regularly and record the day's intake.
Eat a full meal at regular times.

protocols.title: Repeat the measurement
protocols.summary: Confirm the deviation with a second measurement under controlled conditions.

steps.text: Repeat the measurements with the same device and the same posture.
Check that the device is worn correctly and charged.
Record the result as a new observation.

protocols.title: Notify the onboard medical officer
protocols.summary: Put the evidence in the medical officer's hands when the deviation is persistent or converging.

steps.text: Share the engine's evidence summary with the onboard medical officer.
Agree the next review point with the onboard medical officer.
Record the notification in the timeline.
